sentences.translation: Harry raised his head, only Mr. Weasley, Mr. Diggory, and Cedric were still standing, but they also looked disheveled by the wind, while everyone else fell to the ground.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses descriptive words to paint a picture of the characters' appearance after being affected by the wind. The structure '只有...但也是...' emphasizes the contrast between those still standing and those who have fallen.
